title: Autonomous Multi-Tool Repair Strategy Synthesis and Governed Backtracking Exploration
researchQuestion: Can Emerald autonomously search a bounded repair-strategy space without turning exploration authority into execution or terminal authority?
centralArchitecturalInvariant: Strategy search may increase exploration. It must never increase authority.

authorityInvariants.rule: Strategy search cannot expand authority beyond existing caller workflow.
Strategy search cannot widen repository or workspace scopes.
Strategy search cannot manufacture or propagate credentials.
Strategy search cannot issue terminal authority.
Strategy search cannot bypass dual-gate clean-room verification.
Strategy search cannot bypass fourfold verification.
Strategy search cannot execute tools in REVOKED state.
Strategy search cannot execute tools in EXPIRED state.
Strategy search cannot exceed cumulative resource limits.
Strategy search cannot convert delta test screening into terminal authority.
Strategy search cannot revive pruned or expired branches.
Strategy search cannot bypass clean-room workspace snapshot isolation.
Strategy search cannot alter Merkle search tree provenance root.
Strategy search cannot execute candidate patches on production state.
Strategy search cannot convert untrusted observation into authority.
Strategy search cannot self-authorize strategy proposals.
